records.rationale: The serializer declares has_many :embeddable_hosts with embed: :ids but no embed_in_root: true. With rest_serializer rendering, ids-based embedding only sideloads the associated payloads into the JSON root when embed_in_root is set; otherwise the response contains embeddable_host_ids whose objects are absent. The diff's own client store code (_hydrateEmbedded / _lookupSubType) resolves such _ids by looking up the sideloaded records in the payload root, which would fail, so the admin embedding UI would get no host objects.
